description: This file defines a React context for managing project state in a digital audio workstation (DAW) application. It includes hooks, a provider component, and functions for handling project data such as tracks, clips, transport controls, and persistence interactions with external services.

methods.name: useProject()
methods.description: Hook to access project state and actions from React components.

methods.name: ProjectProvider({ children, audio })
methods.description: React component that provides project state, actions, and context to its children. Manages project data, transport, editing state, autosave logic, and integrations with audio engine and external services.

methods.name: addTrack
methods.description: Adds a new track to the project, defaulting to 'audio' type.

methods.name: removeTrack
methods.description: Removes a track from the project by its ID.

methods.name: addClip
methods.description: Adds a clip to a specified track.

methods.name: setBpm
methods.description: Sets the project's BPM and updates the audio engine accordingly.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the transport position and seeks the audio engine.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads project data from a JSON file.

methods.name: exportAudio
methods.description: Renders the project offline to an audio blob and initiates download.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Saves the current project state via external service.

methods.name: loadProject
methods.description: Loads project data given a project ID using external service.

methods.name: renameTrack(trackId, newName)
methods.description: Renames a specified track, trimming input and providing a default name if necessary.
